issues.issue: The Bucegi Sphinx and Babele are natural rock formations; Caraiman Cross is a built memorial in the same massif. The park administration and monument owner independently establish their roles and locations, and the park plan treats the heavily visited plateau route toward the cross. The cross stands on a secondary Caraiman peak, so the corrected caption uses the shared Bucegi location without placing it directly on the plateau or Babele rocks. The alternative route through the massif is factual. Sfinx stored salience0.50 is below an easy threshold, but these nationally recognized tourist landmarks are not specialist trivia. No hiking advice or distance is embedded.
